Name: Diagonal Paths of Doom
Author: TaelFayre
Description:
[size=4][b]Description
[/b][/size] Adds a custom Tilesheet for mod usage and mapping purposes, preview images show it all,[b][color=#b6d7a8] they are seasonal too!!

[/color][size=4]Usage
[/size]For Players:[/b]
 Install like a content patcher mod, any mods that require this will load it just fine.

[b]For Modders:
[/b] Load the tilesheets into your Tiled map and use it :D

[b][size=5]Permissions
[/size][/b] You're allowed to use this tilesheet in your mods, whoever, [color=#e06666][b][u]you must not include any of my textures in your mod folder[/u][/b][/color], this mod should be a dependency and you must redirect this to download it individually, [color=#6fa8dc][b][u]all the donations and points from this mod will be forwarded to charity[/u][/b],[/color] whoever you are free to receive donations or points from your mod that requires this, tho it would be encouraged(not required) to do the same and make a change in someone's life :D

[size=3][b]Compatibility
[/b][/size] Currently Supports Vanilla and  Vibrant Pastoral Recolor (Thx to ZoeDoll#5259 :D)
 No Support for other recolors so far, but if you want to support it feel free to make one and dm me on discord for me to add it to this mod officially with you credited for the support
 If you plan to make this compatible with a recolor, lemme know on [color=#6d9eeb]Discord Tael#5761 [/color]and I'll include your addition in this mod with credits.

[b][size=5]Support me on [url=https://ko-fi.com/taelf]Ko-fi!!![/url][/size][/b]

[size=4][b]Credits
[/b][/size] ZoeDoll#5259 For making the Vibrant Pastoral Recolor patch.
 Saelym#7149 For fixing the JSons for Vibrant Pastoral Recolor support to work.
